company.shortDescription: Shielded is an insurance brokerage that arranges personal and commercial insurance cover for clients across Australia.
company.description: Shielded is an insurance brokerage that arranges personal and commercial insurance cover for clients across Australia. The company provides broking services for motor, home and contents, landlord, strata, construction, owner builder, business package, public liability, professional indemnity, farm, aviation, marine, travel, life, income protection and other specialist insurance needs. Shielded supports clients from quote through placement, renewal and claims management, including 24/7 claim lodgement options and online self-service for policy documents and amendments. Its brokers compare policies from multiple insurers, obtain quotes, and help tailor coverage to individual and business risk profiles. Shielded also offers dedicated services for sectors such as transport, mining, hospitality, waste and recycling, and North Queensland property owners.
